title: Mold Remediation Estimating Schedule: Work-Plan Visit Pricing
content:
**Price.** The Mold Remediation work-plan visit takes the base visit hours of 2 hours, and the work-plan line amount is the visit hours times the tier's supervisor hourly rate, rounded to the cent, half up.

**Pricing basis for this line.** For the work-plan visit line, and only for that line, the amount is the scheduled visit hours times the tier's supervisor hourly rate; the pre-removal asbestos sampling line and the bagged debris haul-off line are priced under their own schedules, and every other scope line remains billed at the tier's unit rate for its code times the quantity performed, with labor the customer asks to have performed in the after-hours window billed at the hourly rate times the after-hours labor multiplier.

**Visit hours.** The visit hours are the hours of the site walk together with every other hour scheduled for the visit. The hours are summed before they are multiplied by the tier's supervisor hourly rate, and the product is rounded once to the cent, half up.

**Warranty work.** A company warranty job is performed at no charge and carries no work-plan visit line; its work-plan figure is 0.00 and nothing is booked.

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Base visit hours | 2 hours |
| Supervisor hourly rate | The tier's figure in the Mold Remediation labor rate schedule |
| Funding source | The job record; company warranty means no line |

**Worked example, hypothetical rate.** On a tier whose supervisor hourly rate were 118.35, a visit of 2 hours is priced at 2 multiplied by 118.35, which is 236.70.
